purpose: Literature-grounded acceptance bands: a 5 ns / 2 fs OpenMM calibration run must reproduce these published pancreatic-lipase MD observables before any production run is trusted (R19). Every number below was verified against the primary-source full text on 2026-09-09; unverified claims from earlier drafts were corrected or removed.
verification_note: Corrections vs draft v1.2.0: DOI confirmed 10.2147/DDDT.S84052 (a research model had hallucinated S87313); the 50 ns extension with 98% Ser152 occupancy belongs to the LEAD complex (zinc 85893731), not orlistat; the Ser152 distances 2.05/8.47/15.35 A belong to lead/ejected hits respectively; one unverified Rg numeric range (2.65-2.75 nm) was dropped; 'protein+ligand consistent RMSD from 2.5 ns' is the lead complex, not orlistat.

CAL-01.band: 1.0-3.0 A plateau, drift < 0.5 A over final 2 ns
CAL-01.source: L1 V2015: protein RMSD 1.25 -> max 2.5 A (fluct 6-8 ns, stable to 10 ns); L5 Mughal 2025: 2.0-2.5 A after 10 ns; L7 Life 2026: 0.15-0.22 nm

CAL-02.source: L1 V2015: orlistat ligand RMSD 1.2-4.8 A over 10 ns

CAL-03.band: mean final-2-ns min distance < 6.0 A (ejected ligands: 8-15 A)
CAL-03.source: L1 V2015: lead Ser152 distance 2.04 -> 2.05 A (before/after MDS); ejected hits 1.85 -> 8.47 A and 1.73 -> 15.35 A; L3 Tran 2024: orlistat beta-lactone ~2.55 A from Ser152 OH

CAL-04.band: >= 0.50 of final-2-ns frames with Ser152 H-bond/contact
CAL-04.source: L1 V2015: orlistat Ser152 H-bond occupancy 64% over 10 ns

CAL-06.source: L7 Life 2026: core catalytic triad stable in both complexes; L5 Mughal 2025: RMSF 0.1-0.3 nm

CAL-07.source: L1 V2015: RMSF maintained below 3.0 A with orlistat

CAL-08.band: < 0.5 A (std of Rg over final 2 ns)
CAL-08.source: L7 Life 2026: stable Rg ~1.97 nm throughout (health criterion; no verified numeric range for PL Rg in L2)

CAL-09.source: L1 V2015: complex energy stable at -450 kcal/mol from 8 ns of the 10 ns run

CAL-10.source: standard NPT 1 bar / 310 K health check (implicit in all cited NPT studies)

CAL-11.source: 310 K physiological setpoint (runbook); 300-310 K across cited studies

CAL-12.source: L1 V2015: sustained H-bond network (Ser152 + Phe77 throughout, 'small naps'); L2 Zhang 2026: good binders keep > 3 H-bonds most of the simulation

short_run_validity: L1 V2015: the LEAD complex shows consistent RMSD from 2.5 ns onward, and complex energy is stable from 8 ns of a 10 ns run
L1 V2015: the same study's LEAD was extended to 50 ns — conclusions held and the Ser152 interaction rose to 98% (no regime change)
L6 catechin 2022: the catechin system equilibrates in ~5 ns (chlorogenic ~40 ns; orlistat complex flat after ~55 ns of 100 ns)
L7 Life 2026: both 100 ns PL complexes equilibrate within 20 ns, then flat RMSD/Rg — a 5 ns window samples the equilibrated regime of a well-behaved pose
L1 V2015: discrimination is retained at 10 ns — orlistat keeps Phe77+Ser152 (64-77%) while 3 of 4 weaker hits lose ALL interactions (Ser152 distance 8.47/15.35 A)
validity_argument.decision_rule: ALL 12 gates PASS => pipeline validated (inputs, solvation, FF assignment, integration, analysis all literature-consistent); any FAIL => debug before production (R19).
validity_argument.scope_note: The 5 ns window follows ~1 ns of B1-B5 equilibration (total ~6 ns of dynamics) and is a PIPELINE calibration (inputs, solvation, FF assignment, integration, analysis), not a binding-mode discovery run. Well-behaved poses plateau within it (lead from 2.5 ns; catechin ~5 ns); if CAL-01 is still rising at 5 ns, extend to 10 ns (V2015's own window) before judging the pipeline — a FAIL is always the conservative outcome.
